summary: Front door with three upper window panes and lower boards. One distinct CC BY 4.0 pack part passes Subphase 5.0 after selected-source preservation, static checks, viewed front/rear captures and isolated RTX 4090 physics; robot/expert qualification remains pending.

measurements.inspected_coordinate_system: source USDZ Y-up, centimeters before normalization

component_review.frame: Original frame component [0]; fixed and collidable.
component_review.panel: Original leaf component [5, 6]; moving and collidable.
component_review.handles: Original handle components [1, 2, 3, 4]; moving and collidable.
component_review.other: Original window plane remains visual and collidable.

modifications: Select this named single-leaf door and its matched source frame from the six-model USDZ pack; retain the original pack and its CC BY texture.
Apply a 1.000 uniform full-assembly scale to keep the fitted leaf within 1.80–2.40 m; proper Y-up to Z-up rotation centers the opening at the floor without reflection.
Infer the revolute axis on the positive-width jamb opposite the source handle, at the outer leaf face; no manufacturer hinge axis is given.

Initial 0.4% fit stopped at 1.7 degrees because the back leaf corner enters the opposite jamb during early rotation. The original leaf exceeds that inner jamb by 1.41 mm and the header by 0.62 mm. The 1.3% uniform Panel/Handle fit about the leaf center and hinge face, plus -2.37 mm width centering, yields 6.32 mm per jamb and 12.20 mm above the leaf. The inferred hinge stays on the hinge-side outer face; leaf, handles, glass (if any) and frame retain collision.

Preserve all modeled frame, leaf and handle collisions. Partition only the source U-frame, with cuts 2 mm inside the inner jamb/header boundary so coplanar jamb faces stay in side cells and the central aperture is not filled by one convex hull.
Begin closed and already unlatched; no separate projecting latch/bolt is modeled.
limits: Hinge location and the 1.3% moving fit are simulation approximations inferred from modeled geometry; no manufacturer hinge measurements were available.
The geometry-derived isolated opening limit is not robot opening evidence; Subphase 5.1 expert qualification was not run.
